mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations fall, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, or average return in high inflation periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,300,000 units in a month signals real estate market weakness, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1,300.0, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), recession risk increases, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5%, or average return in late-cycle periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
